reason: Same symptom (Verify-Rip false-quarantining clean DVDs) but two different root causes and fixes: 7169ae (06-24) is counting benign ffmpeg DTS warnings as errors; 52203a (06-30) is PowerShell 2> line-wrapping splitting already-filtered benign lines into countable fragments. The second bug occurred after the first fix; both lessons stand independently.

a8aaf5 (06-24) identified tail -F locking the log but explicitly flagged an unresolved second cause (log didn't resume after killing the monitor). b1871d (07-18) declares that mystery SOLVED: orphaned tail.exe/grep.exe from stopped Monitors hold the locks. Newer doc resolves the older doc's open caveat and carries the full prevention guidance.

reason: 74ef33 documents layer 2 as built (match runtime against any disc title, discdb candidate first in guesses). 8adc9e records the same-day bug and fix that changed both behaviors: match only against the MAIN feature and demote the discdb candidate to last. The build record's mechanism description is outdated; 8adc9e is current.

Same theme (title order != episode order; subtitle content ID) but complementary, non-redundant content: 84a78d (S4) establishes the two unreliability axes and the subtitle extraction/matching method; 12cb75 (S2) adds that even the correct 4-episode block is internally scrambled, so EpsPerDisc EpStart alone is insufficient and content-ID is mandatory. Neither replaces the other.

Two complementary same-day policies that cross-reference each other: c13b6a diagnoses dual-drive contention as the corruption cause (single-drive rule); c61fd2 sets per-drive media assignment (Pioneer DVD-only, LG for BD). Different claims, both needed.
